How to make a setup code
Make a setup code

A setup code is a QR code holding your sign-in details or recovery key, so you don't type them on the keypad.

1. Save the setup page to this phone.
2. Move it to a computer (USB cable, Bluetooth or SD card).
3. Open it in a browser and fill it in. It works offline and sends nothing anywhere.
4. Scan the QR code it shows with MatChat.
